main_text.p: fateor, sive invidia ab arte, sive ab animo proficiscatur: sed tamen si invidendum alteri, justa erit æmulatio, saltem non adeo iniqua, quæ ideo, quod alium advertamus fortiorem, non quod peritiorem. Quicquid sit, id equidem negari non poterit, quin illi, qui in armorum exercitio sunt artifi-ces, statim ad arma procla-ment, non aliter atque ad deos tutelares; nec tam fortunæ a-leam, & martis eventum ancipitem respiciant, quàm quidem securitatem, & regulam artis, cui confidunt, rectitudinem. Ut non tam victo-riam poscant ab animo, quàm ab arte, non à fortitudine, quà à corporis agilitate. Quod dico, in tantum verum est, ut quondam in Gallià non caru-erit aliquà notâ turpitudinis, aliquem optimum esse gladi-atorem, id est artis scrimiæ peri-

page.notes: Printed long s appears as f in several places (e.g. "profifcifcatur"); I normalised it to s. The first word "proficiscatur" is uncertain at the letter level: [?] is not marked in the text, so please check it against the scan. Hyphenated line-end words are kept with their printed hyphens. The last word "peri-" is a line-end break; the continuation is on the next page, and it is shown here as the last text line, not as a catchword. Accents on à, Gallià, quàm and notâ are kept as printed.
